_comment: Hand-maintained. Every post that appears in the Diaries hub, and the shelves they sit on.
diaries.html is generated from this file by scripts/build-diaries.mjs. Adding a post is
one entry here plus a build — there is no CMS and no database, deliberately.
A category renders as one horizontal rail. A category with NO posts is not rendered at
all: an empty shelf on a page whose whole job is to show there is something to read is
worse than a shorter page. So the six categories below are the full vocabulary, and the
page grows into them as posts are written. Order here is order on the page.
Fields on a post:
id       stable slug, used for nothing yet but will be the anchor when posts get pages
cat      must match a category id below
title    the card's heading
blurb    one or two sentences; the card truncates nothing, so keep it short
href     where the card goes
date     ISO. Sorts the rails and picks the four on the Tram 22 grid and the homepage
photo    key into images/derived/manifest.json, or null for a spice-gradient card
kicker   the small line above the title. Usually the place or the dish
The five restaurant entries point at anchors on restaurants.html rather than at pages of
their own. That page holds the reviews, carries the Review structured data and has the
search ranking for 'indická restaurace praha' — splitting it into five thin pages would
throw all of that away to gain nothing a rail cannot already do.

posts.title: Contemporary Indian wear on the streets of Prague
posts.blurb: Not Goa-hippie, not festival sari. The new age of Indian wear — earthy palettes, hand-loomed craft, avant-garde fusion — and exactly how to style it into a European wardrobe.

posts.title: Annamalai
posts.blurb: Cooked to order in a dim underground room in Nové Město, with the TV blaring Indian songs. Tastes vary day to day, the way fresh cooking does. The only South Indian I keep going back to.

posts.title: INDelicious Bistro
posts.blurb: Street food from across India, in Nusle. Super tasty, and somehow I never leave bloated. Pav bhaji, vada pav, bhel.

posts.title: Dosa Dosa
posts.blurb: Fully vegan South Indian on Újezd, and a perfect breakfast stop. California dosa, uttapam, buckwheat noodles, and cold brew worth staying for.

posts.title: Pastva
posts.blurb: A rotating menu in Anděl, friendly staff, and dishes that have no business being this good without animal products. Burgers, risotto, dumplings, borscht.

posts.title: Palo Verde Bistro
posts.blurb: Dreamy decor on Žitná — mushroom lamps and cosmic skies. The spinach chimney and the parmesan burger are the reason to come back.
